title: Direction contract v1.2 — shared definitions
description: IDs, state assertions and invariant checks shared by the v1.2 direction artifacts. Assertions are evaluated against the existing model state signature (lib/direction_contract/contract.py: model_state_signature) produced by replaying the compiled visual_timeline — no pixels involved.

scene_id.description: Director scene id, e.g. SC009. Production scene ids (scene_plan) are a different namespace.

qualified_id.description: Scene-qualified id of a beat, state, action, object or invariant: <scene_id>/<local id>, e.g. SC009/A02. Canonical everywhere downstream (beats, timeline events, lineage, binding, deviations).

narration_anchor.description: Exact words of the approved script. Resolved to seconds only after TTS + forced alignment (compile_timeline).

assertion.description: A check on the model state signature. 'path' is dot-separated into the signature: elements.<id>.visible, elements.<id>.attrs.<attr>, measures, active, view.<key> (element models); timeline_rail signatures use their own keys. An aggregate assertion combines several numeric paths.

freedom.description: Implementation decisions a worker may take without a deviation. Anything not listed for a REQUIRED_LOCKED scene is not free.

fingerprint.description: contract_fingerprint() of the approved 40 + 41 pair (canonical JSON, approval block excluded).
